LESSON: READING 15.4.1 POEMS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.4: Reading 15.4.1 Poems
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 15.4.1 Poems, part of Strand 15 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: when dramatising. 1. Why are poems recited but not read? 2. How can you say what is in the poem in your own words?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify the ideas in the poems,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 15.4.1 Poems in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. derive the lessons learnt in the poem,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 15.4.1 Poems in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. recognise the role of poems in addressing societal issues. ● Guide learners to outline the subject matter and share with peers. ● Guide learners to identify the messages conveyed in the poems and make notes. ● Guide learners to highlight lessons learnt from the poems and discuss the lessons brought out through the relationship between characters in the poem. ● Let the learners present them in posters or in tactile cards to be displayed in the notice boards for peer review. ● In groups, guide learners to recite and dramatise the given poems for enjoyment. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 15.4.1 Poems together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Problem solving is enhanced as learners get ideas from poems on how to solve problems of self and others.

● Self-efficacy is enhanced as the learner recites and dramatises poems.
